description: adds a held-out set of file and directory cases whose phrases say what a file does, with the script that runs and scores them
stamps the version 0.9.3 in the manifest, the lockfile and the changelog heading
adds a second paired-agent pilot run under enforced isolation with cost measured per pair, and the scripts that set it up and collect it
stamps the version 0.9.0 and writes its changelog entry about the unsure band that keeps a record saying nothing either way
gives the stdin picker a second round over its finalists with its own prompt, so a description of behaviour lands on the implementation rather than on the page that documents it
stamps the version 0.8.3 and writes its changelog entry about crash coverage per journal step and skipped live tests
adds the live test suite together with the plain-text inventory of its test names and titles
stamps the version 0.8.1 and writes its changelog entry about a remote branch resolving to the bare name git accepts and the finals widening to twenty-four
rewrites the front page around four worked examples with recorded pictures, and adds the demo fixtures and the guide pages they run on
caps the keyless batch at sixty records because the service refuses seventy-five with a spending limit, and reports that refusal as unavailable instead of a protocol error
stamps the version 0.7.0 and records the known limit that a name, not the content, decides which file matches
adds the user configuration directory lookup and a shipped recipe file describing pull requests, issues, CI runs and stashes
implements the lexer that was a stub, parsing prefixes, suffixes, inline options and flags out of the argument vector
lets the stdin picker read byte records in any split mode and run a finalists round instead of one flat ranking
replaces a long list of per-phase plan issues with the two-sides vision document and its plan
stamps the version 0.4.0 with its dated changelog heading
rewrites the redaction tests so diff lines and token counters survive untouched while secret assignments and known key formats are masked
adds the rule to the agent instructions that documentation is written in the present tense with no meta and no retrospective language
rewrites the health check's help text so it names the backend that answers and whether a key was needed
adds the plugin and marketplace manifests and the agent skill file that teaches agents the command line tool
adds a one-line bold tagline to the top of the front page
adds the rule to the agent instructions forbidding every form of file deletion, even on scratch files
adds the privacy page and the robot-mode reference describing what leaves the machine and the machine envelope
implements the blake3-keyed disk cache with a seven-day expiry
carries the service request id through to the metadata and makes an unknown answer type parse without failing the whole response
rewrites the plan document's goal, tech stack and module map, and sets the launch cut line
keyless batches of at most 60 records
note: the one phrasing hunch-e4os quotes verbatim; it nearly quotes its target subject line
